summary: ASTRO-GAMBIT is an interactive, real-time 3D planetary outpost systems engineering and resource management simulator built for web browsers. It places the user in the role of Mission Commander of a 6-person deep-space surface habitat operating over a 30-Sol expedition across three progressive mission phases (Level 1: Sols 1–5, Level 2: Sols 6–15, and Level 3: Sols 16–30). Unlike arcade space games, ASTROGAMBIT models authentic NASA closed-loop life support and energy balance constraints where every engineering decision introduces a physical trade-off across competing subsystems. The simulator integrates five interactive 3D surface modules on a single electrical kilowatt bus: the Sabatier Habitat Core (ECLSS), the Solar & RTG Reactor Array, the Aeroponic Bio-Dome Bay, the Superconducting Mag-Shield Core, and the newly integrated ISRU (In-Situ Resource Utilization) Regolith & LOX Refinery Plant. Commanders must balance real-time kilowatt allocations (100 kW baseline bus), respond to stochastic environmental crises (Coronal Mass Ejections, Sabatier seal degradation, electrostatic dust storms, cryogenic eclipses), execute tactical quick-actions, upgrade 3D hardware tiers, and pass formal Level Clearance Gates requiring technical prerequisites and Commander Initials sign-off.
details:
ASTRO-GAMBIT

3D PLANETARY OUTPOST ENGINEERING SIMULATOR -

1. PROJECT CORE & GAMEPLAY LOOP

- Objective: Command a 6-person planetary research outpost for 30 Sols on either the Moon (Shackleton Crater) or Mars (Jezero Crater), keeping Power, O2 / ECLSS, Biomass / Food, and Mag-Shield above zero.

- Kilowatt Power Bus Balancing: Dynamically allocate a baseline 100 kW generation budget across four competing subsystems (ECLSS O2, Mag-Shield, Hydroponics, and ISRU Reserve) using real-time sliders; exceeding generation triggers a Bus Overload power drain penalty (0.55 x deficit kW per Sol).

- Multi-Level Scoring & Authorization Gate: Earn points for advancing Sols (+10 PTS), resolving crises (+15-20 PTS), ISRU runs, and module upgrades (+25 PTS). Clearing Level 1 (Sol 5) triggers a Congratulations screen with a +30 Point Bonus, displays the total point count, verifies technical prerequisites, and requires Commander Initials (2-4 characters) to unlock Level 2 and Level 3.

2. PLANETARY THEATER PHYSICS

- Lunar Theater (MOON): Simulates hard-vacuum conditions at Shackleton Crater with higher baseline radiation shield drain (-6%/Sol) and O2 loss (-5%/Sol), offset by lower baseline power draw (-6%/Sol).

- Martian Theater (MARS): Simulates Jezero Crater's thin 95% CO2 atmosphere, offering lower baseline shield (-4%/Sol) and O2 drain (-4%/Sol) at the cost of higher baseline power demand (-8%/Sol) and dust storm solar attenuation (-22% generation).

3. INTERACTIVE 3D OUTPOST ARCHITECTURE (THREE.JS WEBGL)

- Sabatier Habitat Core (HABITAT / ECLSS): Central pressurized cylinder and dome with a rotating communications dish; upgrades add an upper habitation deck and increase O2 efficiency.

- Solar & RTG Array (SOLAR/RTG): Nuclear radioisotope core flanked by sun-tracking solar wings; upgrades add +12 kW base bus capacity and secondary collector rings.

- Aeroponic Bio-Dome (BIO-DOME): Geodesic dome housing illuminated crop racks; upgrades add auxiliary domes and boost daily biomass output (+4 kg/Sol per tier).

- Superconducting Mag-Shield Core (MAG-SHIELD): Emitter spire with levitating plasma toroids projecting a protective forcefield dome over the base; upgrades increase radiation attenuation (+6% per tier).

- ISRU Regolith & LOX Plant (ISRU PLANT): Northern perimeter refinery featuring an ilmenite/Sabatier cracking tower, glowing thermal coils, dual spherical cryogenic LOX/LH2 tanks, and an animated rotary regolith auger drill.

- Realistic Lunar Surface: Procedural 1024x1024 PBR regolith albedo and micro-crater bump textures, 220x220 cratered topography with raised ejecta rims and central peaks, and 68 scattered 3D lunar basalt boulders.

4. DYNAMIC CRISIS EVENTS & TACTICAL QUICK-ACTIONS

- 6 Crisis Scenarios: Coronal Mass Ejection (CME), Sabatier Scrubber Seal Degradation, Electrostatic Regolith Dust Fouling, Aeroponic Nutrient Bio-Film Clog, Subsurface Water-Ice Prospecting, and Cryogenic Shadow/Night Cycle—complete with 3D visual effects and trade-off decision chips.

- 4 Quick-Action Buttons: Fuel Cell (-80 kg Biomass -> +18% Power), Sinter Armor (-15% Power -> +16% Shield), Bio-Harvest (-12% O2 & Power -> +65 kg Biomass), and ISRU Extract (regolith/ice cracking for O2 and power).

5. TECH STACK & POST-MISSION DEBRIEF

- Technologies Used: Three.js (r128) for 3D WebGL rendering, ray casting, and camera physics; Tailwind CSS with custom glass morphic HUD overlays; and Tone.js for procedural Web Audio synthesizer sound effects.

- Analytics & Grading: Generates an HTML5 Canvas 30-Sol Resource Telemetry Curve and awards a final systems engineering grade (S, A, B, C, or F) upon mission completion or failure.
